# Hydra Sync 1.8.0

Per-game sync that actually syncs on click — plus opt-in per-game modes for automatic passes.

## What's new

### Per-game sync happens immediately

Right-click any game (or multi-select several) → `Hydra Sync` and you get one-shot
actions that run **right now**, for just those games:

- `Sync playtime now`
- `Sync achievements now`
- `Sync playtime & achievements now`

Each action reads Hydra for the selected games, applies the change, and reports the result
in a completion notification — including when no Hydra match was found, so you know
nothing was silently skipped. These actions work even when the global **Sync playtime** /
**Sync achievements** switches are off, and even when the game has a stored mode that
would normally exclude that kind of sync. Asking for a specific game now does exactly that.

### Per-game modes are still there (opt-in)

The stored per-game modes remain available as separate items, for when you want a game to
always (or never) take part in the automatic and full-library passes:

- `Always sync: playtime and achievements` — both (default, also clears an override)
- `Always sync: playtime only`
- `Always sync: achievements only`

The active one is marked `(current)`, modes are stored per game in `sync_state.json`, and
the global switches stay master switches — a stored mode can only narrow what happens.
The main menu (`@Hydra Sync → Sync now`) still syncs the whole library.

## Upgrade notes

- The old game-menu item **"Sync Hydra playtime & achievements"** is gone. It ran a
  full-library sync regardless of what you had selected; use **`Sync playtime &
  achievements now`** to sync just the selected game(s), or **`Sync now`** in the
  `@Hydra Sync` main menu to sync everything.
- Nothing to re-sync and no database changes — existing stored modes keep working.
- As of 1.6.0, automatic syncing is opt-in; enable **Auto-sync** in the extension settings
  if you want the scheduled passes, otherwise syncing happens on demand.

## Install

1. Download `HydraSync-1.8.0.pext` from the assets below.
2. Double-click it and confirm the install (or extract it into
   `%APPDATA%\Playnite\Extensions\A76358E9-BFA2-4189-B6F3-2307EA4E217B\`).
3. Restart Playnite.

Settings live at **Add-ons → Extensions settings → Generic → Hydra Sync**.
